visual.general_description: Six stacked Sanger-style chromatogram strips labeled A to F, each with a red arrow near the center.
visual.detailed_description: The image is a single figure of six horizontally oriented chromatogram strips stacked vertically on a white background, with bold letters A to F at the left of the strips. Each strip has a small legend box at its upper left, colored peak traces on a gray baseline and a row of colored base letters along the bottom. A red downward arrow marks a position left of center in every strip. The bold base printed at the arrow is "A" in strip A, "C" in strips B and C, and "G" in strips D, E and F; strips A, B, D and F show overlapping smaller peaks at the arrow and strips C and E show a single peak. No names, identifiers or dates are visible.

panels.general_description: Sequencing chromatogram strip labeled A, the top of six stacked strips, with a red arrow above one position.
panels.detailed_description: Panel A is the top of six stacked chromatogram strips. A bold letter "A" is printed to the left of the strip and a small legend box at its upper left lists the four colors with the letters G, A, T and C. Colored peak traces (black, green, red, blue) run across a gray baseline with a row of base letters along the bottom. A red downward arrow above the strip points at one position left of center; the bold base letter at that position is a green bold letter "A", with a small blue peak overlapping a green peak in the trace there.
